name: linklingo-miniapp
description: LinkLingo as a local MentraOS miniapp. Live rare-word glossing, captions, and translation on smart glasses, backed by a slim Gemini backend.

scripts.dev:local: sh -c 'LINKLINGO_PORT=${LINKLINGO_PORT:-3240}; export MENTRA_PUBLIC_LINKLINGO_BACKEND_URL=${MENTRA_PUBLIC_LINKLINGO_BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:3240}; echo "[dev:local] backend :$LINKLINGO_PORT  ·  miniapp -> $MENTRA_PUBLIC_LINKLINGO_BACKEND_URL"; pids=""; cleanup() { kill $pids 2>/dev/null; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; PORT=$LINKLINGO_PORT bun --watch backend/src/index.ts & pids="$pids $!"; bun run miniapp:dev & pids="$pids $!"; wait'
scripts.dev:doppler: doppler run --project linklingo --config dev --preserve-env -- bun run dev:local
scripts.backend:dev:doppler: doppler run --project linklingo --config dev --preserve-env -- sh -c 'PORT=${LINKLINGO_PORT:-3240} bun --watch backend/src/index.ts'
scripts.miniapp:pack: cd miniapp && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./miniapp.json').version") && rm -f build/com.mentra.link-$VERSION.zip && mkdir -p build && cd dist && zip -qr ../build/com.mentra.link-$VERSION.zip .
scripts.pack: MENTRA_PUBLIC_LINKLINGO_BACKEND_URL=https://linklingo-miniapp-dev.mentraglass.com bun run miniapp:build && bun run miniapp:pack
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:backend && bun run typecheck:miniapp
